svg.title: 強さは数字で決めず、相手の息と体の硬さを見て上げ下げし、痛いと言われたら手を離す。

text.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif
Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif
Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif

g.text: 1. 手のひらを浅く当て、ゆっくり増す

text.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif

g.text: 2. 見る: 息／肩の押し返し／眉

text.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif

g.text: 3. 一度だけ聞く「今のはどう？」

text.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif

g.text: 4. 息を吐いて肩が下がる

text.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif
Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif

g.text: 5. 息が止まる／体が硬くなる

text.font-family: Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif
Hiragino Sans, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: 強さは数字で決めず、相手の息と体の硬さを見て上げ下げし、痛いと言われたら手を離す。
